THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Steak & Fries with Chimichurri

Bavette steak is the most underrated cut. Fast cook, insane flavor, and it slices beautifully against the grain. Pair it with a no-judge chimichurri (Spiceology seasoning + olive oil + vinegar) and air fryer fries. Kids swap to pork breakfast patties — zero resistance.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~620 cal | ~45g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Rest the steak 5 minutes after cooking — this is NON-NEGOTIABLE. Skip it = dry steak.

Ingredients

FRIES (shared)

  • Checkers/Rally's frozen fries (~1 serving per person)

CHIMICHURRI

  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1.5 tbsp Spiceology Chimichurri seasoning
  • 1 tbsp red wine vinegar
  • Dash chili flakes

ADULT

  • 6 oz bavette steak per person
  • SPG seasoning (salt, pepper, garlic)
  • Cooking spray

Option 1

  • 1.5 pork breakfast patties per kid
  • Raw carrots (baby or sticks)

Contains pork kid version

STOP. Fries are done, steak is resting, patties are cooked. Plate differently — adults get steak + chimichurri, kids get patties + carrots.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.FRIES FIRST. Air fry at 400°F for 12-15 min. No oil, no spray. Shake halfway.
  2. 2.SEAR STEAK. Season bavette with SPG. High heat stainless pan + cooking spray. 2-3 min per side.
  3. 3.REST. Pull steak, rest 5 minutes. Cook pork patties in the same pan, 5 min per side.
  4. 4.CHIMICHURRI. Mix olive oil + Spiceology chimichurri seasoning + red wine vinegar + chili flakes. Let sit 5 min.
  5. 5.SLICE. Cut steak thin against the grain.

Adult — Steak + Chimichurri

  1. 6.PLATE. Sliced bavette + fries. Spoon chimichurri over the steak — not on the fries.

Kid — Pork Patties + Fries + Carrots · Option 1

  1. 6.PLATE. Cut patties into small pieces. Fries on side. Raw carrots. No sauce needed.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Steak + Chimichurri: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Pork Patties + Fries + Carrots: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Slice THIN against the grain — wrong direction = chewy mess.
  • Chimichurri needs 5-10 min to sit after mixing — don't skip or it tastes flat.

If something fails

Steak is chewy / tough: You either overcooked it, didn't rest it, or sliced with the grain. 2-3 min per side, rest 5 min, slice thin AGAINST the grain.

Chimichurri tastes flat / raw: You didn't let it sit. Mix it, wait 5-10 min. The vinegar needs time to bloom the dried herbs.

Fries are soggy: Air fryer too crowded. Single layer, 400°F, no oil needed. Shake halfway.

Kids won't eat steak: That's why you have pork patties. Don't force it. Same fries, add carrots, done.

Storage and reheating

Store: Steak is best fresh. Chimichurri keeps 3-4 days in fridge.

Reheat: Don't reheat steak in microwave — slice cold for steak salad, or quick pan sear.

Lasts: Chimichurri: 3-4 days. Steak: eat same day.

Estimated nutrition

~620 cal | ~45g protein.

620 cal / 45g protein is the adult plate built with the No-Judge Chimichurri below — Spiceology blend, olive oil, red wine vinegar. The filmed episode used a ready-made Costco chimichurri jar as a shortcut, so don't apply these numbers to the jarred version; check that label instead. Same dinner either way.
